title: Cover Fly
description: Twelve Beatles records and a reel of film. Tap a cover and it shrinks and tosses itself on an arc into the next frame of the strip, which opens a slot, catches it with a jolt and a flash. Tap it on the reel, or catch it mid-air, and it flies home the same way.
intent: One flight finished to the edge: a cover thrown from the grid into a film-strip queue on a live-tracked arc, interruptible and reversible at any point of the flight.
